Parliament Adjourned Amid Opposition Demands for Minister's Statement

India's Parliament experienced disruptions during the Monsoon Session, with both the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha being adjourned multiple times. The opposition demanded a statement from Union Minister Amit Shah regarding a protest crackdown. The Lok Sabha was adjourned until 2 pm on one occasion, and until noon on another. The session is scheduled to conclude on August 13. Separately, the Gujarat Assembly's Monsoon Session is set for September 8-10, and the Uttar Pradesh Assembly's Monsoon Session commenced with Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath stating its importance.
